evidence_classification_legend.PHYSICALLY_VERIFIED: Observed in a controlled exchange with the physical VOD700.
evidence_classification_legend.CAPTURE_VERIFIED: Observed in a genuine USBPcap capture made from the official updater or reconnect flow.
evidence_classification_legend.DYNAMIC_ANALYSIS_VERIFIED: Observed through controlled process or API observation. No such claim is currently required for this record.
evidence_classification_legend.STATIC_ANALYSIS_SUPPORTED: Recovered from the updater PE and independently bounded by code/data references.
evidence_classification_legend.FIRMWARE_CODE_SUPPORTED: Recovered from decoded device firmware. No such claim exists yet because no executable firmware image was recovered.
evidence_classification_legend.INTERNET_CORRELATED: Public-source correlation only; never proof of identity or protocol behavior.
evidence_classification_legend.REPLAY_VERIFIED: Validated against a synthetic/replay fixture, not the physical device.
evidence_classification_legend.INFERRED: A bounded interpretation drawn from multiple sources but not directly demonstrated.

evidence.claim: Standard descriptor reads report the USB profile above.
The bundled DM100 WinUSB INF maps USB\VID_0483&PID_5265&REV_0200 and the updater's device-interface GUID; the installer was not run.

transport.api_path: SetupAPI -> CreateFileA -> WinUsb_Initialize -> WinUsb_QueryPipe -> WinUsb_{Read,Write}Pipe with overlapped I/O

evidence.claim: The updater enumerates pipes and routes its interrupt helper through selectors 1 and 0.
The observed endpoint directions match the static selector map.
All retained observed 16-byte request and response frames satisfy the SUM8 framing rule.
The updater's frame builder writes 55 AA and the sum of bytes 0..14 into byte 15.
Offline parsers reject malformed framing and validate captured layouts.

commands.name: storage_query
commands.semantic_meaning: The updater uses the value as a capacity boundary; it is treated as a read-only capacity/storage query, while underlying storage type remains unknown.

evidence.claim: The policy-gated 0x0B request produced the canonical 0x8B response and 0x02000000 value once.
The official updater sent the exact request on 0x01 and received the exact response on 0x81.
The updater builds this frame, validates 0x8B, decodes bytes 3..6 little-endian, and uses the result in bounded tail-region calculations.
Replay and parser fixtures validate the exact 16-byte request/response contract.

commands.name: addressed_bulk_read_shape
commands.semantic_meaning: The official updater uses the command for bounded tail-region retrieval and then reads a framed 4 KiB bulk payload. Read-only semantics for arbitrary addresses are not established, so dispatch stays blocked.

evidence.claim: Two successful 0x06/0x86 exchanges at 0x01FB0000 and 0x01FB1000 were followed by valid 4096+8 byte bulk-IN frames; the third request was cancelled before an acknowledgement.
The feedback worker starts at capacity-0x50000, performs 32 requests in 0x1000 strides, requests 0x1008 bytes from bulk IN, and writes a host Feedback.bin output.
Offline correlation preserves the cancelled third request as incomplete and validates only complete 4096+8 frames.

commands.name: update_prepare_page_count
commands.semantic_meaning: Observed only in an official-updater firmware-transfer state. The field equals ceil(DM100 McuCode.bin size / 4096); no active implementation is permitted.

evidence.claim: The exact 0x03/0x83 exchange occurred before the bulk update block.
The update worker builds command 0x03 using a big-endian ceiling page count before transferring chunks.

commands.name: update_block_handshake
commands.semantic_meaning: Observed immediately before an official-updater bulk OUT frame; no active implementation is permitted.

evidence.claim: The exact 0x01/0x81 exchange occurred immediately before the 0x02 bulk OUT submit.
The dangerous update worker sends the full-page handshake before a pipe-selector-3 (endpoint 0x02) bulk write.

bulk_frames.layout: AA55AA55 + 4096 data bytes + big-endian SUM32 over the preceding 4100 bytes
bulk_frames.captured_data_pattern: Two captured pages were all FF; that data pattern does not define all possible pages.

evidence.claim: Two complete bulk frames have valid SUM32 trailers of 0x000FF1FE.
The updater requests 0x1008 bytes, skips the first four bytes, and copies 0x1000 bytes into the host buffer.

bulk_frames.layout: 55AA55AA + 4096 opaque artifact bytes + big-endian SUM32 over the preceding 4100 bytes

evidence.claim: The official updater submitted one valid 4104-byte bulk OUT frame.
The update worker copies a source 4 KiB page into this frame and appends a big-endian additive SUM32.
The capture contains the first opaque 4 KiB bulk data page.
PID 0x5265 selects DM100 McuCode.bin and the update worker uses source pages unchanged in the observed bulk layout.
The offline matcher verifies a 4 KiB page by checksum, SHA-256, and byte equality without writing a device.
The VOD700 Update worker formats ExtFlashDat.bin and invokes the dangerous worker with stage command 0x04 after the DM100 command-0x03 stage succeeds.

update_artifacts.limitations: No command-0x04 USB transfer, response, payload page, or device effect is retained. The artifact is opaque and not a recovered flash image.
